description: Python source-client adapter (coordinator/sources.py) with one function per endpoint and a SOURCE_MODE mock<->sandbox switch, plus stdlib-unittest coverage of the URL/auth SELECTION logic (no network). Depends on FEAT-001/FEAT-002 only for the endpoint list/shapes, not for code imports. Matches coordinator/coordinator.py style (stdlib urllib, typed, no heavy deps).
steps: Create c:\Users\AnudeepSaiNunna\workspace\Kiro\logging\dowsure-oracle\.worktrees\source-mocks\coordinator\sources.py. Read coordinator/coordinator.py first to match its urllib.request.Request + urlopen + json.loads style and typing. No third-party imports.

Define SOURCE_MODE read from env, default 'mock' (any value other than 'sandbox' is treated as mock). Define per-provider base URLs from env with sensible defaults: AMAZON_SP_BASE_URL, ALICLOUD_BASE_URL, QICHACHA_BASE_URL, GUTU_BASE_URL. In mock mode the base URLs come from the deployed mock ApiUrl env values (and must NOT require any credential). In sandbox mode defaults point at the real hosts: Amazon https://sandbox.sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com, AliCloud https://qrymobile.market.alicloudapi.com, Qichacha https://api.qichacha.com, Gutu https://turningapi.valuemap.cn.

Implement one function per endpoint (typed signatures, return parsed JSON + status): get_order_metrics, list_financial_event_groups, list_transactions, alicloud_tel_three, qichacha_check(path), gutu_panorama_check(body). Each builds the URL from the selected base URL + path and issues the GET/POST via urllib. For the 6 GETs attach query params; for the 1 POST send a JSON body. Add an x-api-key header from an optional MOCK_API_KEY env (used when calling the deployed, auth-gated mock) - absent/empty is fine for local stubs.

Wire the exact Amazon sandbox fixture params as the sandbox-mode DEFAULT query params so sandbox returns 200 out of the box: getOrderMetrics marketplaceIds=ATVPDKIKX0DER, interval=2022-08-01T00:00:00-07:00--2022-08-02T00:00:00-07:00, granularity=Total; listFinancialEventGroups MaxResultsPerPage=1, FinancialEventGroupStartedAfter=2019-10-13, FinancialEventGroupStartedBefore=2019-10-31; listTransactions postedAfter=2023-03-07, nextToken=jehgri34yo7jr9e8f984tr9i4o. In mock mode these params are harmless (the mock ignores them).

Attach auth ONLY in sandbox mode, read from env, never hardcoded: build_amazon_access_token() exchanges LWA_CLIENT_ID/LWA_CLIENT_SECRET/LWA_REFRESH_TOKEN at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token and returns the token for the x-amz-access-token header (optional AWS_REGION/SigV4 only if present - leave a clearly-marked hook, do not require it); AliCloud sets header Authorization: 'APPCODE ' + ALICLOUD_APPCODE; Qichacha implements qichacha_token(timespan) = md5(QICHACHA_APP_KEY + Timespan + QICHACHA_SECRET_KEY) and sends key + Timespan + Token headers; Gutu sends Authorization: 'Bearer ' + GUTU_TOKEN. In mock mode NONE of these are read or required.

Expose small pure helpers so selection logic is unit-testable without network: resolve_base_url(provider, mode), build_amazon_params(mode), build_auth_headers(provider, mode, env) (returns {} in mock mode). Keep network I/O in thin wrappers that call these.

Create c:\Users\AnudeepSaiNunna\workspace\Kiro\logging\dowsure-oracle\.worktrees\source-mocks\tests\test_sources.py (stdlib unittest, same sys.path.insert pattern as tests/test_coordinator.py). Cover: (a) mock mode needs ZERO creds - build_auth_headers returns {} for all four providers with an empty env; (b) mock mode resolves to the mock base URLs; (c) sandbox mode resolves to the correct real hosts; (d) sandbox mode builds the exact Amazon fixture params; (e) qichacha_token produces the md5 of app_key+timespan+secret for known inputs; (f) sandbox auth headers have the right shape (APPCODE prefix, Bearer prefix, x-amz-access-token present) using fake env values - with NO network call (monkeypatch/avoid the token exchange).
acceptance_criteria: `python -m unittest tests.test_sources` passes with no network access.
sources.py has one function per endpoint and the pure selection helpers; mock mode requires no credentials.
Sandbox-mode Amazon params equal the documented fixtures; auth headers match provider formats; no secret value is hardcoded.
verification: Run from the worktree root: `python -m unittest tests.test_sources` exits 0.

`Select-String -Path coordinator\sources.py -Pattern 'APPCODE','x-amz-access-token','Bearer','auth/o2/token','ATVPDKIKX0DER'` confirms the sandbox wiring is present; `Select-String -Path coordinator\sources.py -Pattern 'amzn1','Atzr|','APPCODE [A-Za-z0-9]'` returns NO hardcoded credential values.

Endpoint functions (each returns Tuple[int, Any] = (status, parsed_json); each takes optional env dict last):
  - get_order_metrics(env=None)                      # amazon GET /sales/v1/orderMetrics (getOrderMetrics fixture)
  - list_financial_event_groups(env=None)            # amazon GET /finances/v0/financialEventGroups (listFinancialEventGroups fixture)
  - list_transactions(env=None)                      # amazon GET /finances/2024-06-19/transactions (listTransactions fixture)
  - alicloud_tel_three(mobile, name, idcard, env=None)  # alicloud GET /telThree
  - qichacha_check(path, params=None, env=None)      # qichacha GET <path>
  - gutu_panorama_check(body, path='/panorama/check', env=None)  # gutu POST (the 1 POST)

Pure selection helpers (no network, unit-testable):
  - source_mode(env=None) -> 'mock'|'sandbox' (default 'mock'; any non-'sandbox' => mock)
  - resolve_base_url(provider, mode, env=None) -> str   (provider in {'amazon','alicloud','qichacha','gutu'})
  - build_amazon_params(mode) -> {'getOrderMetrics':{...},'listFinancialEventGroups':{...},'listTransactions':{...}} (exact fixtures in sandbox, empty in mock)
  - build_auth_headers(provider, mode, env=None, timespan='', amazon_access_token=None) -> {} in mock mode
  - qichacha_token(app_key, timespan, secret_key) -> md5 hex
  - build_amazon_access_token(env=None) -> str  (LWA token exchange; the only networked auth helper)

Constants: MODE_MOCK='mock', MODE_SANDBOX='sandbox', SANDBOX_BASE_URLS, PROVIDER_ENV, LWA_TOKEN_URL, MOCK_BASE_URL_DEFAULT='http://localhost:4010'.
Env vars (sandbox-only, read from env, never hardcoded): SOURCE_MODE, AMAZON_SP_BASE_URL/ALICLOUD_BASE_URL/QICHACHA_BASE_URL/GUTU_BASE_URL, MOCK_API_KEY (x-api-key for gated mock), LWA_CLIENT_ID/LWA_CLIENT_SECRET/LWA_REFRESH_TOKEN, optional AWS_REGION (SigV4 hook), ALICLOUD_APPCODE, QICHACHA_APP_KEY/QICHACHA_SECRET_KEY/QICHACHA_TIMESPAN, GUTU_TOKEN. Mock mode requires ZERO creds. Grep confirms wiring present (APPCODE, x-amz-access-token, Bearer, auth/o2/token, ATVPDKIKX0DER) and NO hardcoded credential values (amzn1/Atzr|/APPCODE<literal> absent).
